description: This file contains the definition of the GeoZone class in the Opencart admin module, responsible for managing geographical zones within the system. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, and fetching geo zone records from the database, as well as related zones and relationships.
external_methods: Database query methods: query, escape, getLastId

classes.name: GeoZone
classes.description: Class providing CRUD operations and retrieval functions for geographical zones in the Opencart admin localization module.

methods.name: addGeoZone
methods.description: Creates a new geo zone record in the database with specified name, description, and optional zone relationships.

methods.name: editGeoZone
methods.description: Updates an existing geo zone record identified by its ID, replacing its data and associated zones.

methods.name: deleteGeoZone
methods.description: Deletes a geo zone record and its related zone associations from the database.

methods.name: getGeoZone
methods.description: Retrieves a specific geo zone record by its ID.

methods.name: getGeoZones
methods.description: Fetches a list of geo zone records, with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalGeoZones
methods.description: Returns the total count of geo zone records.

methods.name: addZone
methods.description: Associates a zone with a geo zone by inserting a record into zone_to_geo_zone.

methods.name: deleteZones
methods.description: Deletes all zone associations for a specific geo zone.

methods.name: getZone
methods.description: Retrieves a specific zone_to_geo_zone record by its ID.

methods.name: getZones
methods.description: Fetches all zone associations for a given geo zone ID.

methods.name: getZonesByCountryId
methods.description: Retrieves all zone associations for a specified country.

methods.name: getTotalZones
methods.description: Counts the total zone associations for a given geo zone.

methods.name: getTotalZoneToGeoZoneByCountryId
methods.description: Counts how many zone associations exist for a specific country.

methods.name: getTotalZoneToGeoZoneByZoneId
methods.description: Counts how many zone associations exist for a specific zone.
